maya: Quick quarterly milepatch rollup — pinging owners and deps. TL;DR: runtime-v2 canary shipped (Tom), console observability UI shipped (Rachel), embeddings prefix cache slipped ~2w (Eva). I updated the OKR sheet: https://go/okrs/quarterly-milestones

maya: Owners/asks: Tom — verify canary SLOs for 24h; Rachel — infra ACLs for dashboard retention; Eva — re: embeddings tests, pair with Dan; I'll mark statuses once we have EOD updates.

dan: I can take the test flakes today. @eva can you paste the failing trace?

eva: Sure — failing trace: ```AssertionError: expected 512 tokens but got 0
 at EmbedBatchProcessor.process (embed/processor.py:142)
 unit_test_embed.test_batch_padding```

eva: Repro command: `pytest tests/unit_test_embed.py::test_batch_padding -k docker --maxfail=1 -q`

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: runtime-v2-canary on 2025-10-12T19:10:23Z — logs: https://logs/re/runtime-v2-canary :rocket:

maya: Next steps: Tom — post perf dashboard link and confirm SLOs in 24h. Rachel — ping infra with ticket #4123 and add ACL owner. Eva + Dan — pair and aim for a PR today. I'll update the OKR doc by EOD. Tagging PM for roadmap impact: @luke.

tom: Will post dashboard in #eng-runtime in ~30m. If p95 spikes persist we'll rollback canary to v1.9 while we patch.

rachel: Ticket #4123 created and assigned to infra-rotations. ETA EOD Wed. cc @infra.

dan: WIP PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/578 — fixes key encoding and adds unit to cover padding. Running CI now.

maya: Thanks — short async check. If no major blockers by EOD we'll mark runtime and console as SHIPPED; embeddings stays AT-RISK. Please ping here if anything slips further. :thumbsup:
